svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Rounded $0 Local logo, v4
svg.desc: The rounded ticket family has a broad capsule-like left end that curves naturally into the same local endpoint. The outer silhouette is a single contour and a single green fill. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
